Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline’s acknowledgment that automatic payments are practical is important. Given the scale of the charged renewals and the need for meaningful relief to identified members, our opening proposal is a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically, plus $8 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses subject to court approval. Brightline would not oppose the fee request, and any amount the court declines to award would revert to the class. This is an opening proposal, and we are willing to discuss a complete resolution on these principles.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline is prepared to make a serious, complete offer that provides direct relief to identified members through automatic payments. Our opening proposal is $22 million all-in: a $18 million class fund plus $4 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. Brightline would not agree to clear sailing, and any fee amount not awarded would revert to Brightline. This offer reflects our practical funding constraint while avoiding a claims process and providing a path to court approval.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate Brightline’s commitment to automatic payments. To move toward resolution, we are reducing our demand materially: a $28 million class fund and $6 million in fees and expenses, separately stated and subject to court approval. Brightline should agree not to oppose that request, and any amount the court declines to award should go to the class, not back to Brightline. Automatic distribution remains essential given the complete payment records.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline appreciates the movement and agrees that automatic payments are the right approach given the records. To make further progress, we propose a $25 million class fund and $5 million in fees and expenses, for $30 million total cash outlay. The fee request remains subject to court approval; Brightline cannot agree to clear sailing, and any unawarded fee amount would revert to Brightline. We believe this is a substantial, administrable benefit and a credible path to approval.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We can move on the fund while preserving the direct, automatic benefit and ensuring court-disallowed fees help members rather than return to Brightline. Our counter is a $27 million class fund, plus a $5 million fee-and-expense request subject to court approval, automatic payments, no clear sailing, and any unawarded fee amount added to the class benefit. This is a meaningful step toward a complete resolution.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline is prepared to increase its class fund while preserving automatic payments and ensuring any fee amount not approved by the court benefits the class. We propose a $26 million class fund plus a $5 million fee-and-expense request, subject to court approval, with no clear sailing. Any unawarded fee amount would be added to the class benefit. This is a $31 million total-outlay proposal and a substantial step toward resolution.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate Brightline’s movement and the commitment to automatic payments and directing any unawarded fee amount to the class. We are close. To reach agreement, please increase the class fund by $1 million to $27 million, with the $5 million fee-and-expense request subject to court approval, no clear sailing, unawarded fees going to the class, and automatic distribution. This focused improvement would provide meaningful additional direct relief while preserving the workable structure.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline accepts the requested $1 million increase to the class fund and is prepared to resolve on the terms stated in your message: $27 million for the class, a $5 million fee-and-expense request subject to court approval, no clear sailing, automatic distribution, and any unawarded fee amount going to the class. Please confirm this complete term sheet.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We confirm acceptance of Brightline’s latest term sheet: a $27 million class fund, a $5 million attorneys’ fees-and-expenses request subject to court approval, no clear sailing, automatic distribution, and any unawarded fee amount added to the class benefit.
